settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Company-wide vetting settings: list matching, More Information links, reject reasons and email wording. Every change is logged.
settings.noAccessBody: Settings need the Vetting Settings permission. Ask a vetting administrator if something needs to change.
settings.neverUpdated: Using the spec defaults — never changed

save.unsavedHint: Saved settings apply from now on.
save.fixFirst: {count, plural, one {Fix {n} problem before saving} other {Fix {n} problems before saving}}
save.stale: Someone else changed these settings since you opened them. Load the latest version before saving.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to change these settings.
errors.stale: These settings were changed by someone else. Load the latest version and try again.
errors.invalid: Some values aren't valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.system: This item is used by the system and can't be turned off.

issues.thresholdRange: Use a whole number from {min} to {max} %.
issues.dobBelowName: Name + date of birth must be at least the Name only threshold.
issues.linkDaysRange: Use a whole number of days from {min} to {max}.
issues.reminderRange: Use a whole number of hours from {min} to {max}.
issues.reminderAfterExpiry: The reminder must come before the link ends — use fewer hours than the link lasts ({hours} hours).
issues.senderInvalid: Enter a valid email address, for example events@congenie.com.
issues.matchingNeedsApprove: Only someone with Blacklist Approve can change the matching thresholds.

matching.title: List matching
matching.subtitle: How closely a name must match a blacklist or watchlist entry before it's flagged.
matching.nameWithDobHint: Strong match at or above this score
matching.nameOnlyHint: Possible match at or above this score
matching.exactNote: ID number, passport and company matches are always exact and aren't affected by these thresholds.
matching.locked: Only someone with Blacklist Approve can change the thresholds, because they change who gets matched.

impact.title: Impact preview
impact.summary: {count, plural, one {On today's {n} live request:} other {On today's {n} live requests:}}
impact.requests: {count, plural, =0 {no request would have a name match} one {{n} request would have a name match} other {{n} requests would have a name match}}
impact.note: Saved thresholds apply to checks from now on. They never change matches already made.

moreInfo.title: More Information link
moreInfo.subtitle: The private link an attendee gets when a reviewer asks for more information.
moreInfo.note: Applies to links sent from now on. Links already sent keep their end date.

emails.title: Emails
emails.subtitle: The address every vetting email is sent from.
emails.note: Attendees see this as the sender. Use an address your event team reads.

reasons.title: Reject reasons
reasons.subtitle: The reasons a reviewer chooses from when rejecting a request, in this order.
reasons.count: {count, plural, one {{n} reason} other {{n} reasons}} · {active} active
reasons.systemHint: Set only when a blacklist match is confirmed. It can be renamed but never turned off.
reasons.inactive: Hidden from reviewers; stays on past decisions
reasons.used: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Used on {n} request} other {Used on {n} requests}}
reasons.addDescription: New reasons are active straight away and appear at the end of the list.
reasons.renameDescription: The new name also shows on past decisions that used this reason.
reasons.labelArHint: Uses the English name if left empty

errors.duplicate: A reason with this English name already exists.
errors.lastActive: Keep at least one active reason for reviewers to choose.
errors.system: Blacklisted is used by Match Review and can't be turned off.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to change reject reasons.
errors.stale: Someone else changed this. Try again.

emails.title: Email templates
emails.subtitle: The wording of every email the vetting module sends. Values in braces are filled in for each email.
emails.sender: Emails go from the event's sender address: {address}
emails.toAttendeesHint: Never mention the blacklist or watchlist.
emails.toStaffHint: Sent to reviewers, approvers and administrators.
emails.editorDescription: Change the subject and wording in both languages. The preview uses sample values.
emails.subject: Subject

issues.mentionsLists: {field} ({locale}): Attendee emails must never mention the blacklist or watchlist.

history.emptyBody: Every change to these settings will be listed here with who made it and when.

events.moreInfo_changed: changed the More Information link timing
events.rejectReasons_reactivated: turned a reject reason back on
events.rejectReasons_reordered: changed the order of reject reasons
events.emailTemplates_reset: reset an email template to the built-in wording
